name: validate-reuse-lifecycle-metadata-convergence
title: Make fresh validation reuse converge across trusted lifecycle metadata writes
description: RED-confirmed workflow bug: after a fresh routine validation PASS, trusted lifecycle metadata such as the TEST transition process event can leave process-events.jsonl dirty. The next mandatory validate correctly selects zero-command reuse but returns infra_failure canonical-pass-persistence-failed instead of atomically persisting the reused PASS. Fix only canonical same-flow metadata convergence while preserving fail-closed rejection for pre-existing human, external, forged, malformed, or unrelated dirty state.
